natural_language_statement:
For fixed source data $d$ and every height $H>0$, the finite set of actual interpolation rows is nonempty, and hence

$$\operatorname{actualRowCount}_d(H)>0.$$

The zero multi-index together with the first row label gives an explicit row because the row weights and structural parameters are positive.
theorem_title: Positivity of the actual interpolation-row count
